about: Kept-group schedules of the yoked filter controls. Each entry copies one verifier-filter run's kept counts per step and names the prompts the control keeps. Written by make_keep_schedules.py, which reads only the kept and prompt_index fields of the filter runs' training records. This committed file is the reference, and the trainer reads it without drawing any randomness.

rule.first_update_step: default_rng([constant, task_code, int(w), seed]).permutation of the lexicographic list of n-prompt sets, and draw d keeps the set at position d
rule.later_update_steps: default_rng([constant, task_code, int(w), seed, d + 1]) draws permutation(batch_prompts) at every step, and draw d keeps the first n entries, sorted
